nodes.label: Rundale Documentation Hub
nodes.description: Master navigation hub organizing durable design, speculative ideas, active and archived plans, ADRs, requirements, research, development guides, and agent references.

nodes.label: Roadmap Status Authority
nodes.description: The feature-status matrix in requirements/roadmap.md is declared authoritative; the index provides an orientation summary and purpose-based status vocabulary.

nodes.label: Purpose-Based Document Taxonomy
nodes.description: Documentation is classified by purpose and lifecycle: durable design, speculative ideas, active plans, archived plans, and architectural decisions, each with explicit status vocabulary.

nodes.label: Active Visual Client Direction
nodes.description: The semantic chat-first shell with responsive DOM art is the active default; Pixi notebook, diorama, and Godot tracks are retained as retired, proposed, or exploratory records.

nodes.label: 1820s Ireland Research Archive
nodes.description: A structured research collection grounds language, society, material culture, economy, institutions, spirituality, environment, and historical context used by world-building and NPC dialogue.

edges.description: The hub explicitly delegates authoritative feature status to the roadmap matrix.
